newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA cotton export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net Upland sales of 15,100 running bales (RB) were four-fifths below the previous week and the 4-week average.

The major increases for China (9,900 RB), Brazil (4,400 RB), Sweden (3,600 RB), and Indonesia (2,900 RB) were partially offset by reductions for Japan (5,000 RB), Canada (3,200 RB), Mexico (3,000 RB), and Hong Kong (2,600 RB).
Sales of 50,400 RB for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year were primarily for South Korea (15,800 RB), Brazil (13,200 RB), and Japan (11,900 RB).

Exports of 115,400 RB were off 6 percent from the previous week and 13 percent from the 4-week average. Asian destinations accounted for 52 percent of the week's shipments; Western Hemisphere, 28 percent; West European, 18 percent; and African, 2 percent.
